shortDescription.default: A configurable Like / reaction button for SharePoint pages

longDescription.default: Adds a Like button (thumbs up, heart, star or any emoji) to a modern SharePoint page. Uses the page's built-in likes or a SharePoint list, with configurable text, size, alignment and style.
